dimensions.detail: The documented purpose is Feishu Sheets management, and the script implements matching create, read, write, append, row/column, and worksheet operations against Feishu API endpoints.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly exposes write and delete actions, but it does not include explicit confirmation, preview, or backup guidance for destructive row/column or worksheet deletion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no auto-run installer or hidden setup behavior; the package contains a markdown skill, an API reference, and a readable Python CLI script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The script uses FEISHU_APP_ID and FEISHU_APP_SECRET to obtain a Feishu tenant token; this is necessary for the integration, but the environment variables are less explicit than the listed Feishu permission scopes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background persistence or disk token storage is present; privilege depends on the Feishu app scopes and document access granted by the user.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The documented delete worksheet and delete row/column capabilities are real, but they are disclosed and aligned with spreadsheet management rather than hidden or unrelated behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The CLI performs delete operations without a built-in confirmation flag; this is a user-safety limitation to manage operationally, not evidence of malicious intent.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want the agent to operate on Feishu Sheets. Use a least-privileged Feishu app, limit document access where possible, and review exact spreadsheet tokens, sheet IDs, ranges, and delete requests before allowing changes.
llm.summary: This is a straightforward Feishu Sheets integration that can read, write, and delete spreadsheet content, so it should be used with scoped credentials and care.
